extra.finding: #4 Item head squeezes the name at 200% text, 390 px
extra.why: Measured: .iname 65 px wide and 336 px tall at 200% root font size

extra.finding: #5 Items and people cannot be edited
extra.why: No edit path in the source; fixing an entry means delete, re-add and re-tick
Items say Delete/Deleted, people say Remove/Removed
Placeholders are 'e.g. Ana' and 'e.g. Margherita pizza'; minor copy issue
The renderResult text is one long sentence: 'largest leftover fraction'

extra.finding: #9 Tax accepts any amount up to 99,999.99
extra.why: parseMoney does not check tax against the subtotal

extra.finding: #10 Comma decimal gets an unhelpful generic message
extra.why: The regex rejects 12,50 with the generic 'Use numbers only' message

extra.finding: #11 Pressed tip preset invisible in forced colours
extra.why: The forced-colors block has no aria-pressed rule; system colours override the background

extra.finding: #12 Capital I and lowercase l look alike in system-ui
extra.why: A system-font property, not an app defect; duplicate names are already checked case-insensitively

extra.finding: #14 Polish: Start over silent no-op, RTL padding, preset can't unpress
extra.why: The reset handler returns silently when empty; padding-left is physical; minor
